spec_case: electricity/docs/spec/tools-adapters-plugins.md §2.6 (http's own redirect rule, HTTPRedirectHandler's method/status matrix)
description: A POST to a 303 follows as a GET with no body (two recorded requests); a POST to a 307 is never followed (not an allowed method/status pair for POST) and surfaces as a success with its own status/stderr, since ok = not (fail_on_error and status >= 400) and 307 < 400.
